name: Pendle Ecosystem USDC
oneLiner: pendleUSDC is Pendle Ecosystem's USDC lending vault on Ethereum; shares redeem at NAV when liquidity is available and bear strategy losses.
collateral: USDC lender positions in three Morpho markets secured by PT-reUSD-10DEC2026, PT-sUSDS-26NOV2026 and PT-sUSDE-26NOV2026
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 shares accrue lending interest and realize losses against USDC; direct redemption uses idle USDC and a configured liquidity adapter, subject to market liquidity. In-kind deallocation retains underlying lending-position exposure.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Pendle Ecosystem USDC at ethereum:0x55c1b6e461a6334b567baf0feb5d728715446f05 is an ERC-4626 share over USDC with a code-enforced pro-rata claim on the current Morpho lending inventory. The claim bears lending losses and liquidity constraints, so protocol-position intentionally differs from the fiat-cash parent and older Morpho precedents. Idle USDC=0; complete adapter inventory sums to 57750429995940 USDC atomic units. Asset decimals=6, share decimals=18. convertToAssets(1e18)=1009202 USDC atomic units.
